evidence: GATE-N7 receipt and causal CI already certified

preflight.objective: Define and certify the safe performance-validation scope for N8.7 on Desarrollo, covering load, stress, concurrency, endurance and large-volume behavior without touching main, Produccion, deploy, secrets or PR #2.
preflight.currentState: Desarrollo exposes /health and /health/ready and the Development Render service exposes request-count, p95 latency, CPU, memory and instance-count telemetry. Directed repository search found no dedicated k6/JMeter/Locust/Artillery/NBomber/BenchmarkDotNet performance harness. Existing low-volume telemetry is baseline-only and is not performance acceptance evidence.
scope: Use only Desarrollo and non-production test data.
Exercise representative tenant-scoped authenticated business paths plus readiness endpoints only where causally useful.
Measure p95/p99 latency, error rate, throughput and resource saturation under staged load.
Exercise concurrency for duplicate/race/idempotency-sensitive operations where applicable.
Run controlled stress to a safe saturation boundary, sustained endurance, and large-volume pagination/export/query paths.
Correlate exact candidate HEAD and test window with Render HTTP/CPU/memory/instance telemetry.
outOfScope: treating idle observational telemetry or mocks as equivalent to controlled performance validation
risks: Development free-plan/cold-start/resource limits can distort absolute latency and must be recorded with results.
The current automation runner has no direct outbound network path to the Render URL, so controlled external workload execution may require an authorized network-capable runner at N8.7.G.
No dedicated performance harness was found in the directed repository scan; any harness introduced later must remain scoped, reproducible and non-production.
Performance changes such as indexes/caching/pagination must be evidence-driven; speculative optimization can regress correctness or isolation.
acceptance: B-F introduce changes only when a concrete domain/data/API/frontend/security/observability gap is proven; otherwise close causal N/A with evidence.
N8.7.G must execute controlled load, stress, concurrency, endurance and large-volume validation, or persist an honest external blocker; baseline telemetry alone is not PASS.
Performance results must retain tenant/RBAC correctness, no secrets, P0=0 and P1=0, and preserve functional regression gates.
Thresholds/results must be recorded against the exact tested HEAD and workload profile, including latency, errors, throughput and resource behavior.
preflight.rollback: N8.7.A is evidence-only. Any later runtime/schema/UI change requires its own scoped rollback and causal gate before closure.
preflight.testStrategy: Baseline current Desarrollo telemetry; then at TEST_CI use a bounded staged workload with warm-up, load ramp, safe stress boundary, concurrency races, sustained endurance window and seeded large-volume cases. Capture workload parameters and correlate them with Render HTTP request count/p95 latency, CPU, memory and instance count; re-run focused functional/security checks for any path changed in B-F.
